title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Meetings)
(1) Meetings of the Committee shall be classified as regular and extraordinary meetings. Regular meetings shall be convened once every half year, and extraordinary meetings whenever necessary.
(2) The chairperson shall convene and preside over meetings of the Committee.
(3) Resolutions shall require the affirmative votes of at least two-thirds of incumbent members: Provided, That a resolution on matters under Article 37 (1) 3 of the Act shall also require the affirmative votes of at least two-thirds of the members specified in Article 37 (3) 3 of the Act.
(4) Upon request of a member or where deemed necessary, the chairperson may invite heads of relevant local governments, experts, etc. to attend and speak at meetings.
